items.description: A list of objects that describe the different items available within the menu

sections.description: A list of objects that describe the different sections of the menu

timeSlots.description: A list of objects that describe the time periods that different sections of the menu can be made available within

modifierGroups.description: A list of objects that describe the different modifier groups that will be available to the merchant within the portal to apply to different sections

id.description: ID for the item that is unique to the menu.

name.description: Customer facing name or short description of the item.

sku.description: SKU or PLU for the item in the POS.

description.description: Customer facing, long description of the item.

containsAlcohol.description: Indicates whether or not the item contains alcohol

energy.description: Energy content of each standard item (expressed in kilojoules 'kJ')

price.description: The amount and currency of the item

images.description:
A URL pointing to an image, which could either be a default image or an override image.
To avoid any issues with copyright over images, we have provided the ability to supply a
default image as well as the ability to override the default image with a different image for a
specific partner. Set the 'default' field to be the URL used by default for all Apps. Provide
additional fields for Apps where the default URL should be overridden. For example
providing a URL for a field named "doordash" will mean that menus published to DoorDash
will use that URL instead of the 'default' URL. The complete list of Apps that you can
nominate are:
  - DOORDASH
  - HUBSTER
  - GOOGLE

DEFAULT.description: A URL pointing to a default image that will be used for apps that were not specifically setup.

additionalProperties.description: value for each property should be a valid URL to an image.

options.description: A list of objects describing modifier categories that are available for this item

min.description: The minimum number of modifiers within this option that need to be selected by the customer

max.description: The maximum number of modifiers within this option that can be selected by the customer

items.description: A list of ids referencing the items available within this option that can be applied as modifiers to the parent item by the customer

min.description: The minimum quantity of this modifier that needs to be selected by the customer

max.description: The maximum quantity of this modifier that can be selected by the customer

modifier-group.description: Modifier groups are a convenience added to the schema for managing the options that can be added to items (e.g. within a menu management app). They are, however, not necessary for rendering a menu to a customer

id.description: A unique id that represents the modifier group within the menu

name.description: The name of the modifier group will correspond to the name of any item.options that reference items contained within the modifier group

min.description: This number represents the minimum number of items within this modifier group that a user will have to select if they are applied to an item

items.description: A list of objects whose id's reference items that belong to this modifierGroup

min.description: The minimum quantity of this modifier that needs to be selected by the customer

max.description: The maximum quantity of this modifier that can be selected by the customer

id.description: A unique id that represents the section within the menu

availableTimeSlots.description: A list of ids referencing the timeslots that this section will be available within

items.description: A list of ids referencing the menu items that are available within this section - only parent items will be referenced here, not items that are used as modifiers

modifierGroups.description: A list of ids that reference the modifierGroups that are used in this section. Any item contained within the 'option' of another item will exist within a modifierGroup that belongs to the same section of that parent item

id.description: A unique id that represents the time slot within the menu
